sentences.en: CAROL: Good morning and welcome again to Your City Today.
sentences.zh: CAROL: 早上好，欢迎再次收听《今日城市》。

sentences.en: With me today is Graham Campbell, a councillor from the city council.
sentences.zh: 今天与我一同出席的是来自市议会的议员格雷厄姆·坎贝尔。

sentences.en: He will be telling us about the plan to improve the fast-growing suburb of Red Hill.
sentences.zh: 他将为我们介绍一项旨在改善快速发展的红山郊区的规划方案。

sentences.en: Good morning Graham and welcome to the show.
sentences.zh: 早上好，格雷厄姆，欢迎来到本节目。

sentences.en: GRAHAM: Good morning, Carol.
sentences.zh: GRAHAM: 早上好，卡罗尔。

sentences.en: CAROL: Now, Graham, I understand that there has been a lot of community consultation for the new plan?
sentences.zh: CAROL: 格雷厄姆，我了解到，这项新规划已开展了大量社区意见征询工作，是吗？

sentences.en: GRAHAM: Yes, we've tried to address some of the concerns that local groups told us about.
sentences.zh: GRAHAM: 是的，我们已努力回应当地团体向我们反映的一些关切问题。

sentences.en: People we've heard from are mainly worried about traffic in the area, and, in particular, the increasing speed of cars near schools.
sentences.zh: 我们所听取意见的居民主要担忧该区域的交通状况，尤其是学校附近车辆行驶速度不断加快的问题。

sentences.en: They feel that it is only a matter of time before there is an accident as a lot of the children walk to the school.
sentences.zh: 他们认为，发生事故只是时间问题，因为许多孩子都步行上学。

sentences.en: So we're trying to do something about that.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们正设法解决这一问题。

sentences.en: Another area of concern is the overhead power lines.
sentences.zh: 另一项令人担忧的问题是架空输电线路。

sentences.en: These are very old and a lot of people we spoke to asked if something could be done about them.
sentences.zh: 这些线路年代久远，许多我们接触过的居民都询问能否对此采取一些措施。

sentences.en: Well, I'm happy to report that the power company have agreed to move the power lines underground at a cost of $800,000.
sentences.zh: 好消息是，经与市议会多次协商，电力公司已同意出资80万美元，将输电线路埋入地下。

sentences.en: I think that will really improve the look of the area, as well as being safer.
sentences.zh: 我认为此举不仅将显著提升该区域的整体观感，而且也更加安全。

sentences.en: CAROL: That's good to know, but will that mean an increase in rates for the local businesses in that area?
sentences.zh: CAROL: 这真是个好消息，但这是否意味着该地区本地企业的市政税将有所上涨？

sentences.en: GRAHAM: Well, the power company have agreed to bear the cost of this themselves after a lot of discussion with the council.
sentences.zh: GRAHAM: 经过与市议会的大量讨论，电力公司已同意自行承担此项费用。

sentences.en: This is wonderful news as the council now has some extra funds for us to put into other things like tree planting and art work.
sentences.zh: 这真是令人振奋的消息，因为市议会现在可将这笔额外资金用于其他项目，例如植树和公共艺术建设。

sentences.en: GRAHAM: Now, we've also put together a map which we've sent out to all the residents in the area.
sentences.zh: GRAHAM: 此外，我们还制作了一份地图，并已寄送给该区域所有居民。

sentences.en: And on the map we've marked the proposed changes.
sentences.zh: 地图上已标出拟议的各项变更。

sentences.en: Firstly, we'll plant mature pine trees to provide shelter and shade just to the right of the supermarket in Days Road.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们将在戴斯路超市右侧种植成年松树，以提供遮蔽与阴凉。

sentences.en: In order to address the traffic www.TopSage.com Tapescripts * SAg problems, the pavements on the corner of Carberry and Thomas Street will be widened.
sentences.zh: 为应对交通问题，卡伯里街与托马斯街交汇处的人行道将予以拓宽。

sentences.en: This will help to reduce the speed of vehicles entering Thomas 19C. com Street.
sentences.zh: 此举有助于降低车辆驶入托马斯街时的速度。

sentences.en: We think it's very important to separate the local residential streets from the main road.
sentences.zh: 我们认为，将本地住宅街道与主干道明确区分开来至关重要。

sentences.en: So the roadway at the entry to Thomas Street from Days Road will be painted red.
sentences.zh: 因此，从戴斯路进入托马斯街的路段路面将被涂成红色。

sentences.en: This should mark it more clearly and act as a signal for traffic to slow down.
sentences.zh: 此举应能更清晰地标示该区域，并向过往车辆发出减速信号。

sentences.en: One way of making sure that the pedestrians are safe is to increase signage at the intersections.
sentences.zh: 确保行人安全的一种方法是在各路口增设交通标志。

sentences.en: A 'keep clear' sign will be erected at the junction of Evelyn Street and Hill Street, to enable traffic to exit at all times.
sentences.zh: 在伊芙琳街与希尔街交汇处，将竖立一块‘保持畅通’标志牌，以确保车辆随时均可顺利驶出。

sentences.en: Something we're planning to do to help control the flow of traffic in the area is to install traffic lights half way down Hill Street where it crosses Days Road.
sentences.zh: 为帮助管控该区域车流，我们计划在希尔街中段、即其与戴斯路交叉口处安装交通信号灯。

sentences.en: Now, we haven't only thought about the cars and traffic, of course, there's also something for the children.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们的考虑并不仅限于车辆与交通；我们也为孩子们做了相应安排。

sentences.en: We're going to get school children in the area to research a local story, the life of a local sports hero perhaps, and an artist will incorporate that story into paintings on the wall of a building on the other side of Hill Street from the supermarket.
sentences.zh: 我们将组织该地区在校学生调研一则本地故事——例如一位本地体育英雄的生平事迹——随后由一名艺术家将该故事融入超市对面希尔街另一侧某栋建筑的墙面绘画中。

sentences.en: And finally, we've agreed to build a new children's playground which will be at the other end of Hill Street close to the intersection with Carberry Street.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们已同意新建一座儿童游乐场，位置定在希尔街另一端、靠近与卡伯里街交汇处。

sentences.en: CAROL: Wonderful, now, what's the next stage?
sentences.zh: CAROL: 太棒了！那么下一步是什么？

sentences.en: GRAHAM: Well, the final plan ..
sentences.zh: GRAHAM: 嗯，最终方案……
